assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production transparent game VFX floor texture for the Legendary LIGHTNING spell Wrath of Raijin.
Primary request: an exquisitely intricate flat circular thunder-drum rune seal, viewed perfectly top-down orthographically and centred on a square canvas. Brilliant electric blue, pale gold and white luminous engraving on transparent alpha.
Structure: many concentric sharply divided arcane circles, microscopic abstract runic ticks, interlocking geometric lightning paths, a small stylized three-comma thunder crest at the exact centre, and six smaller drum-crest medallions spaced around the outer ring. Fine jagged lightning filigree weaves between the rings without filling the negative spaces. Clear rotational symmetry, premium high-detail magical craftsmanship, crisp emissive linework and restrained blue glow tightly hugging the lines.
Composition: entire circular silhouette contained within the middle 85 percent of the image, generous transparent margin all around. The centre and all gaps between the lines remain substantially transparent. This must read as a flat rune wheel, not physical drums, not a tilted disc, not a scene.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. No opaque coloured disc or backdrop, no checkerboard painting, no floor, no smoke wall, no character, no text, no lettering, no labels, no UI, no frame, no watermark. A single standalone high-resolution texture.

Composition: the entire group occupies the middle 75 percent of a square canvas. All five drums, lightning branches and sparks fit comfortably inside generous transparent margins. No cropped drums or arcs.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, including gaps between drums. No opaque mist cloud, no painted checkerboard, no black backdrop, no scenery, no floor, no text, no labels, no UI, no border, no watermark. One standalone game texture.
